correctness.rationale: The principal minor retains degree 2; a gap of length g gives the Dirichlet path block 2I-A on g-1 vertices. Independently, for a path with l+1 sites, inclusion-exclusion over its two length-l subpaths shows that the centered second difference of the trace of A^m counts closed walks visiting both endpoints. At m=2l, at least the two endpoint-rooted out-and-back walks contribute. Hence each second difference of h_l is strictly positive at t>0 with the stated coefficient, and the screened objective carries the extra positive factor exp(-mu t). Strict integer unit transfers give the complete equality cases of the extrema; the maximum vector majorizes every positive gap vector, and the balanced vector is the unique minimizing multiset. The rooted descriptions of each balanced labelled set have exactly k anchors. The sine eigenvectors give the stated spectral formula, and positive Gamma/time weights preserve the ranking, including the empty and unique-gap cases. The inequality at lines 60–65 is for the unscreened sum in the display; an explicit bound for the screened objective multiplies it by exp(-mu t). Inspected VERIFICATION.md and verify.py (Python 3/NumPy replay in the frozen directory); its exploration is finite, and the proof does not require executing it.
